brand.title: OTTO’S SECRET
brand.subtitle: Step into a universe of missions, games, short films and scientific wonders. Otto has prepared it all for you.
brand.bookDescription: Dinosaurs, extraordinary animals, space and unbelievable inventions. Real stories for curious minds.
brand.welcomeText: Choose a door. A new adventure awaits behind each one!

missioni.title: Otto’s Seven Secret Missions
missioni.subtitle: The mystery of the Atlas of Wonders
missioni.description: Seven scientific mysteries, clues to collect and a secret to reveal.

museo.title: Museum of Impossible Discoveries
museo.subtitle: Seven rooms. A whole museum to explore.
museo.description: Visit seven themed galleries, solve challenges and complete your explorer passport.

film.title: Science Comes Alive!
film.subtitle: Watch amazing science in motion.

film.detail: The animations are educational reconstructions, not original footage.

colora.title: Color Science with Otto
colora.subtitle: Ten adventures to bring to life.
colora.description: Whales, dinosaurs, robots and space: ten printable coloring sheets.

carte.subtitle: The smartest answer is not always yes or no.
carte.description: Thirty-six illustrated cards for challenging friends and family.
carte.detail: Play on your phone or print a double-sided deck with explanations.
